message.content:
Looking at the sequence: 7, 3, 1, 0, 0, ?

I notice each term follows the pattern **2ⁿ − 1**:

| Term | Expression | Value |
|------|-----------|-------|
| 1st | 2³ − 1 | 7 |
| 2nd | 2² − 1 | 3 |
| 3rd | 2¹ − 1 | 1 |
| 4th | 2⁰ − 1 | 0 |
| 5th | 2⁻¹ − 1 | (non-integer, so stays at 0) |

The exponent decreases by 1 each step (3, 2, 1, 0, …), and once the result reaches 0, it remains 0.

<answer>0</answer>
